title: Add live list checker with admin-managed name lists, claims, limits, totals, and contact info

requirements.text: Implement backend data models and APIs for a live name-list checker: admin can upload/manage a list of names; users can claim a name; the system must prevent duplicate claims and track claim status (available/pending/approved/rejected) along with claimant identifier, timestamp, and UPI ID collected at claim time.

quotes: Integrate a live list checker feature into my existing site. Admin uploads a name list. Users enter their name to claim; if available, it’s marked pending. At claim time, the user must enter their UPI ID. The system records the claimed names, the user’s UPI ID... If a name is already taken, notify the user. Admin reviews claims... via the admin panel.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can upload/replace a name list in the backend and fetch it back for display.
A user claim attempt for an available name creates a claim record with status=PENDING and stores the provided UPI ID.
A user claim attempt for a name that is already pending/approved results in a backend error (or an explicit ‘taken’ response) that the frontend can show to the user.
Backend exposes queries to fetch claim records for admin review, including name, status, UPI ID, timestamp, and claimant principal (or other stable identifier).

requirements.text: Add backend support for admin-configurable limits and totals: admin can set claim limits (e.g., maximum number of pending/approved claims overall and/or per user) and a per-claim rate/amount; backend must compute and expose totals based on claims (at minimum totals for approved claims, and optionally pending totals) and enforce limits during claim creation.

quotes: Admin reviews claims, sets limits... calculates a total based on claims.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set and read back limit settings and per-claim amount settings.
When limits are reached, creating a new claim is rejected with a clear error message.
Backend exposes a totals query that returns computed totals (e.g., approvedCount, pendingCount, approvedTotalAmount, pendingTotalAmount) derived from stored claims and current settings.

requirements.text: Add backend support for admin-managed public contact information, including a WhatsApp number, that can be updated in the admin panel and queried by the user view.

quotes: ...updates contact info (including a WhatsApp number) via the admin panel.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set contact info fields including WhatsApp number.
User-facing query returns the current contact info.
Contact info persists across canister upgrades (state is stable).

requirements.text: Create/extend frontend React Query hooks (in the existing hooks pattern used by frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts) for: uploading/replacing the name list, fetching the list, creating a claim with UPI ID, fetching claim status for a name, fetching admin claim queues, approving/rejecting claims, fetching totals, and getting/setting contact info and limits.
acceptanceCriteria: All new backend methods needed by the UI have corresponding React Query hooks (queries/mutations) with cache invalidation similar to existing patterns (e.g., invalidating list/totals on mutation).
Errors such as ‘name already taken’ are surfaced to the UI via toast or inline messaging (English text).

requirements.text: Add a user-facing ‘Live List Checker’ UI flow that allows a user to: view instructions, enter a name, see availability, and if available submit a claim by entering their UPI ID; the UI must show clear feedback when a name is already taken and show the user the status of their submitted claim (at least pending/approved/rejected).

quotes: Users enter their name to claim; if available, it’s marked pending. At claim time, the user must enter their UPI ID... If a name is already taken, notify the user.

acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a name and submit a claim with a required UPI ID field.
If the name is already claimed, the UI shows an English message indicating it is already taken and does not create a new claim.
After submitting, the UI shows claim status as ‘Pending’ (and updates to ‘Approved’/‘Rejected’ after admin action).
User can see current contact info (including WhatsApp number) in the Live List Checker user view.

requirements.text: Extend the existing Admin Panel (frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx) with a new section/tab for the Live List Checker that supports: uploading/replacing the name list (bulk text input and/or file upload), viewing all claims, filtering by status, approving/rejecting claims, setting limits and per-claim amount, viewing totals, and editing contact info including WhatsApp number.

quotes: Admin uploads a name list... Admin reviews claims, sets limits, and updates contact info (including a WhatsApp number) via the admin panel.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can paste/upload a list of names and submit it; the list becomes active immediately for user checks.
Admin can see a table/list of claims with name, UPI ID, status, and timestamp.
Admin can approve or reject a claim; the claim status updates in the UI after action.
Admin can set limits and per-claim amount, and see totals computed from claims.
Admin can edit and save contact info including WhatsApp number.

requirements.text: Add required backend state upgrade handling for the new live list checker storage (name list, claims, settings/limits, contact info) using backend/migration.mo according to the project’s conditional migration policy, ensuring existing stored data (current comment lists, images, messages, etc.) is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Upgrading the canister does not erase existing unrelated state.
New live list checker state is initialized safely on upgrade if missing.
The canister compiles and deploys with stable upgrade paths.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme for the new Live List Checker pages/sections that matches the existing app’s Tailwind/Shadcn styling but is distinct and consistent (e.g., ‘warm amber + charcoal’ with card-based layout, clear status badges, and accessible form states). Do not use a blue/purple primary theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Live List Checker UI uses consistent typography, spacing, and components (cards, badges, inputs, dialogs) aligned with the existing design system.
Status (Available/Pending/Approved/Rejected/Taken) is clearly distinguishable using consistent badge colors and text labels.
All user-facing text is English.

constraints: Keep all Motoko logic in the single backend actor (backend/main.mo).
Only generate/modify backend/migration.mo if needed for stable state upgrade of new storage.

Do not edit frontend files under immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
No external databases or third-party authentication providers; use the existing Internet Identity integration and existing admin PIN/access-code gating patterns.
nonGoals: Implementing real WhatsApp messaging/notifications or any direct WhatsApp API integration (only store and display a WhatsApp contact number).
Real-time updates via WebSockets or push notifications.
Integrating external payment gateways or on-chain wallet features beyond computing totals from claims.
